turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and when?
Hey! Glad you made it, parking here is a nightmare.
We're not here about the parking, Hale. I asked you a question. Was Owen heard before that zero went in, yes or no?
Love the coat, by the way.
Don't manage me, Hale. You've used up a minute of my twenty on parking and my coat. What do you have?
Okay so, I'm thinking we keep this super chill. You seem like a super chill person.

Super chill. My son has a zero on his record over a machine's guess, and I'm going to the principal's office when I leave here unless you give me something better than that. Who entered the zero, Hale?
